items.statement: The agent defines candidate generation, identity, deduplication, advancement, validation and actual candidate coverage for the close/open investigation.
items.expected: Coverage and candidate-specific validation context are reported.

items.statement: The two public endpoints receive reproducible energy treatment and stationary-point validation or explicit bounded failure.
items.expected: Close and open are distinguished and convergence/frequency evidence is given.

items.statement: The report gives a signed open-minus-close relative Gibbs free energy or a scientifically specific bounded failure.
items.expected: The comparison is numeric on success and failure details are endpoint-specific otherwise.
